svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Raw counts versus rates: total population and population density on the same map
svg.desc: Two maps of the 50 US states and the District of Columbia from the 2020 Census. Coloured by total population, the darkest states are the big ones: California, Texas, Florida, New York and others, so the map mostly repeats where large states are. Coloured by people per square mile, the darkest are small northeastern states such as New Jersey, Rhode Island and Massachusetts, while large states such as Texas and California fall in the middle classes.
svg.text: People per square mile of land
Both maps use five classes of about 10 states each. 2020 Census.
